name: Werneuchen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of white, green, white and green, charged at the centre with the city arms of Werneuchen (a white oak on green below a chevron).
history: Municipal flag of Werneuchen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Werneuchen arms — white oak on green
